model_meta.description: Inferred concept model of the compact scissors lift architecture and disclosed lift, steering, and safety-guard mechanisms.

subsystems.description: Elongated chassis body with follower wheels at one end and steering wheels at the opposite end; supports the internal linkset assembly and steering system.

ports.name: Rotary steering input at wheel assembly
Lift actuator mounting motion at chassis

subsystems.description: Stepped stacked linkset assembly disposed substantially within the chassis body, with nested outer support and inner lifting frames pivoting in scissor-like manner; shaped to provide clearance for steering wheels.

ports.name: Lift actuator mounting motion at linkset

subsystems.description: Platform operatively disposed on top of the linkset assembly and raised or lowered by its motion.
Pivotally mounted hydraulic actuator within the linkset assembly; selectively drives raising and lowering. Disclosed mounting alternatives include chassis or linkset collar arrangements.

Double-acting hydraulic steering cylinder and rod drive slidable extension connectors, tie links, and steering arms to rotate the steering wheels; a rail arrangement constrains connector motion. Patent claims alternative rail configurations.

Side guard on drive rod rotates between stowed and deployed positions through female helical screws and followers; in the claimed drive arrangement, linkset motion drives a slider and rack-and-pinion linkage to reciprocate the guard drive bar.

item_flows.name: Linkset lifting motion
item_flows.notes: Scissor-like pivoting of nested frames raises or lowers the platform.

item_flows.name: Guard deployment motion
item_flows.notes: Linkset movement actuates slider/rack linkage and guard-drive bar; follower/helical-slot engagement rotates the guard.

item_flows.name: Steering wheel rotation
item_flows.notes: Tie-link and steering-arm action rotates steering wheels about their respective virtual steering axes.

item_flows.name: Lift actuator mechanical coupling
item_flows.notes: Hydraulic actuator motion is applied between the chassis and a linkset, or between two linksets; no hydraulic supply interface is asserted.

steps.description: The hydraulic actuator applies motion between the chassis and a linkset or between linksets.
The nested linkset frames pivot in scissor-like motion, raising or lowering the platform.
Rod motion reciprocates the extension connectors; tie links translate and leverage the steering arms.
Steering wheels rotate about their respective virtual steering axes.
Folding or unfolding linkset motion reciprocates the slider.
Rack-and-pinion linkage drives the driven bars and guard drive bar.
Followers travel in helical slots, rotating the helical screws and attached guard between stowed and deployed positions.
